products.title: Magic Link™
products.body_html:
Designed with both you and your dog in mind, the Magic Link can be worn by humans as a belt, a bandolier, or a wrist-strap and it can serve as a slip-on collar or a conventional leash when attached to a separate harness.

products.title: Bed
products.body_html: Our signature memory foam dog bed features simple, minimalist lines and looks right at home with any décor. The exterior is durable, water- and stain-resistant, machine- washable, and UV-resistant.

products.title: Bowl

products.title: Falcon Toy™
products.body_html:
Our Falcon Toy features a custom falcon-claw design with multiple treat cavities to promote both interactive or independent quiet play, while the interlocking shape allows multiple toys to combine for added feeding, tugging, treating, and rolling functionality.

Two types of treat cavities accommodate both dry food (like kibble) and spreads (like peanut butter) simultaneously. The unique colors blend into any decor while also optimizing for your dog's visible color spectrum.

products.title: Crate
products.body_html:
Our signature crate is made from premium bentwood and comes in two finishes—signature and limited-edition walnut. The gate, which comes in metal or clear acrylic, may be secured in place or stored discreetly within the unit. The minimal design blends seamlessly into any home as a side table and balances generous airflow and light in a serene den-like environment for your pet to recover from adventuring.

To make sure your dog adapts well to their new crate, we recommend monitoring your pet closely during the first few days (particularly in the case of very young dogs).

Bed sold separately. Purchase the Fable Crate and Bed together with the Best Selling Rest Set.

Because this is a large furniture item, we cannot accept returns. Please be sure to measure the dimensions before purchasing.

Crates are not currently available to ship to Canada, but all other products are.

The XS/S Crate with acrylic gate is expected to ship in 4-8 weeks.

The M Crate with acrylic gate and the XS/S Crate with white metal gate are expected to ship in 6-10 weeks.

The limited-edition Crate with walnut finish is made-to-order and is expected to ship in 4-5 months.

The L Crate is expected to ship by the end of the year. Please email help@fablepets.com if you have questions.

products.title: Signature Collar

Made from lightweight silicone, with dual attachment points to secure to any leash, the Magic Leash, or the Magic Link, it's perfect for humans and dogs on the move. The twist cap and anti-spin interior allow for easy loading and ensure you'll always have a bag ready.

products.title: adidas Samba OG 'White Black Gum'
products.body_html: A faithful reissue of an iconic style, the adidas Samba OG retains vintage design lines in a contemporary look for a modern lifestyle. This 'Cloud White' variant is built with a full-grain leather upper complemented by suede at the T-toe, serrated Three-Stripes and a contrast heel panel. Bluebird and foil logos authenticate the retro feel. This low-top is completed with a multi-directional tread pattern on the gum rubber outsole.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Gold Swoosh'
products.body_html: A fan of neutrals? Cop the Nike Dunk Low Golden Swoosh Tan! Starting with a smooth eggshell white leather base, this clean-cut and ultra-versatile pair features classy beige overlays and matching laces, tongue tab and heel tab. Meanwhile, the suede Nike Swoosh is in an ochre yellow hue. This curry colour also dresses up the “NIKE” branding on the backside. Finally, you can expect a lightweight feel with this Nike Dunk Low’s white midsole and cream outsole.

products.title: Sporty & Rich x adidas Samba OG 'White Green'
products.body_html: The adidas Samba has picked up a huge new fanbase this past year and with this pair from Sporty & Rich, it’s never been clearer as to why. With there being so much demand for the silhouette, the Samba will probably be the hardest to grab out of the three. Once again, adidas provides the canvas for the Sporty & Rich founder Emily Oberg, to add her artistic touch.

products.title: New Balance 1906D 'Protection Pack - Black'
products.body_html: New Balance’s new 1906D silhouette is next up for the Protection Pack make-up and it is certainly one to get excited for. New Balance has recently paved its way in the footwear scene with its slew of silhouettes of both old and new, resonating with past and present sneakerheads alike. While the 1906D debuted in 2009, New Balance recognises that it fits into the current sneaker shop space better than ever, giving us customers a selection of hot colourways to pick from. The Protection Pack comes in two colourways, this black version and a lighter and brighter 1906D Protection Pack Grey and delivers an edition of the 1906D that most won’t be able to turn down, adding yet another shoe to the collection.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid Wmns 'Black Sail Gym Red'
products.body_html: Even after 37 years, the Air Jordan 1 still reigns supreme. Its classic colourways just work. The silhouette’s latest drop combines a beloved colour arrangement with a distinctive pop of red. Introducing the Air Jordan 1 Mid Black Sail Gym Red. This AJ1 sports the fan favourite “Panda” look, a smooth white leather base with black tumbled leather overlays on the toe cap, the mudguard, the eye stay panel, the collar flap and the heel counter. The profile Swooshes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels follow the rest of the overlays in tumbled black leather. However, a Gym Red collar underlay steals the scene on the upper, creating a vibrant contrast with the rest of the shoe. A Gym Red Jumpman stands out against the black tongue tab and a Gym Red Wings logo is stamped on the lateral collar flaps. A Sail-coloured midsole and a black rubber outsole round out the design of this sneaker.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'True Blue'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘True Blue’ dresses the timeless silhouette in familiar hues borrowed from an OG colourway of the Air Jordan 3. The smooth leather upper combines a crisp white base with contrasting hits of True Blue on the forefoot overlay, Swoosh, and eyestay. A neutral Cement Grey finish is applied to the heel and collar overlay, featuring a retro Wings logo stamped in blue. A woven Nike Air tongue tag completes the OG-inspired aesthetic. Lightweight cushioning is provided by an encapsulated Air-sole unit nestled in the heel of the rubber cupsole.

products.title: New Balance 550 Wmns 'White Bubblegum Pink'
products.body_html: This New Balance 550 delves into a more feminine version of the basketball shoe with hits of pink in all the right places. For the most part, white constructs the majority of the shoe’s upper, allowing the pink to highlight the most interesting elements and details. All the branding has been laden with pink as well as the heel support ridge and tongue piping. The perforated sidewalls make a return as with other releases, a detail which wonderfully balances the dual stitching elements on the panels. The story is much of the same down below with the midsole walking a fine line between the two opposing colours.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low 'Spray Paint Swoosh'
products.body_html: Casual but with a chic touch, the Nike Dunk Low Stencil Swoosh Grey White features a smooth white leather base that serves as the perfect canvas for the light grey tumbled leather overlays and the double Swoosh design consisting of a black and wolf-grey overlapping Nike Checks with a spray paint look. Monochromatic heel tab and tongue tag round off the shoe’s straightforward appearance. Finally, this Nike Dunk Low closes with a lightweight white midsole with full-length cushioning and a black outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Flu Game' 2016
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 12 Retro ‘Flu Game’ 2016 celebrates Michael Jordan’s legendary performance in Game 5 of the 1997 NBA Finals. Battling flu-like symptoms, Jordan lead the Bulls to a 3-2 series lead over the Utah Jazz with 38 points, 7 rebounds, 5 assists, 3 steals, and 1 block. Previously retroed in 2003 and 2009, this 2016 version stays faithful to the OG design with its black tumbled leather upper and varsity red on the mudguard and outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid PS 'Barely Grape'
products.body_html: Boasting a full leather construction that's soft and supple to the touch, the midfoot panel of these Jordans is painted in a crisp white, while the toebox and lacing system both opt for a barely grape hue. Around the ankle and heel, the Jumpman label has added just a touch of rush fuchsia, and this is contrasted by the iconic winged basketball insignia. A striking Swoosh shoots through the laterals and medials, and all of this sits on top of a crisp Nike Air midsole that offers unparalleled comfort and performance, both on and off the hardcourt.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS 'True Blue'
products.body_html: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG issue hits all the marks that AJ1 fanatics have been enamored by over the last half-decade. The signature blue shade touches the forefoot and lace collar overlay, with matching Swoosh and WINGS logos off-setting the cement grey pairing on the heel and ankle collar. A smooth white leather appears via the underlay, matching the solid white outsole. A new shoebox color also appears as the classic OG-style NIKE AIR shoebox is flooded in that nostalgic shade. Jordan Brand really could have added a True Red on the tongue label or even the aforementioned WINGS logo, which leaves us wondering why the omission was made in the first place.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low SB 'White Gum'
products.body_html: Arriving with a low-cut profile, panels from heel to toe are constructed with buttery soft tumbled leather material for a premium look. A crisp white hue outfits the entire upper leaving ony the Swoosh logos and Nike heel branding to deliver a pop of contrast in black.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE Wmns 'Reverse Ice Blue'
products.body_html: The Women's Air 1 Low Se "reverse Ice Blue" trainers come with the Air technology , which consists of a flexible and resistant capsule full of air inside the midsole of the shoe. With this system, the model ensures your ankles and knees, minimizing the impact in each step.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Premium 'Montreal Bagel Sesame'
products.body_html: The Nike Dunk Low Premium ‘Montreal Bagel Sesame’ takes the heritage silhouette from the basketball court to the bakery. A neutral tan finish is executed on the smooth leather upper, accented with a sesame seed print that calls to mind a traditional Montreal bagel. The Swoosh and heel tab are rendered in a bold shade of royal blue, while the sockliner reveals a custom hardwood graphic. Underfoot, a semi-translucent gum rubber outsole yields reliable grip.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Game Royal'
products.body_html: This latest Dunk variant, however, goes back to its roots by presenting a collegiate-style colour arrangement of blue and black leather panels. Nike Swoosh logos on the lateral and medial sides opt for a contrasting white shade, giving the low-top shoes an eye-catching feature. The Beaverton sportswear giant completes this covetable pair with classic branding details on the tongue, insoles, and heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low 'True Blue Cement'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Low 'True Blue Cement' gets a simple true blue, cement grey, and white makeover. True Blue leather lands on the mudguard, eyestays, collar, and heel, while accenting white hits make it onto the toebox and midfoot panel. Tonal blue laces run up the grey tongue, stopping just below the embroidered Jumpman that joins the true blue party. More hits of cement grey can be found on the Nike Swoosh along the midfoot and on the mesh sockliner, though the insole nearby comes in true blue. For the final hit of branding, the heel is home to an embroidered Air Jordan Wings logo in white, piercing off the blue leather. Rounding out the look is the white AJ 1 midsole paired with a cement grey rubber outsole.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low SB 'Black Gum'
products.body_html: The Nike SB Dunk Low “Black Gum” is a forthcoming iteration of the silhouette and it’s strikingly similar to the 2016 Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black White Gum. Suggested to make its debut sometime next year, the low-top simply dons a black nubuck upper that is nicely offset by white tumbled leather Swooshes and midsole. Finally, matching black laces and the highlight gum rubber outsole rounds out the design.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low PS 'Mineral Teal'
products.body_html: Equipped with a Football Grey/Mineral Teal-Pearl Pink color combination, this Nike Dunk Low gets constructed out of a full smooth leather construction on the upper with a light pink noted on the base of the upper along with Football Grey and pastel green hitting the overlays.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid GS 'Valentine’s Day' 2023
products.body_html: Dressed in a Coral Chalk, Desert Berry, and White color scheme. This offering of the mid-top Air Jordan 1 comes constructed in a full leather build with mesh tongues and lining. It features a White base with Pink overlays and a darker shade used on the Swooshes, lining, and rubber outsole. White laces and midsole completes the design.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro SE 'Craft'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE ‘Craft’ makes over Tinker Hatfield’s original 1989 design with upgraded materials. The legacy silhouette sports a light grey leather upper with tonal suede construction on the collar and forefoot overlay. Support wings are built with cracked leather, while gridded suede replaces traditional plastic netting on the quarter panel. Pale Vanilla accents settle on the shoe’s molded eyelets, as well as Jumpman branding hits at the tongue and heel. Lightweight cushioning is provided an off-white polyurethane midsole, featuring a visible Air-sole unit nestled in the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro SE GS 'Craft'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE ‘Craft’ makes over Tinker Hatfield’s original 1989 design with upgraded materials. The legacy silhouette sports a light grey leather upper with tonal suede construction on the collar and forefoot overlay. Support wings are built with cracked leather, while gridded suede replaces traditional plastic netting on the quarter panel. Pale Vanilla accents settle on the shoe’s molded eyelets, as well as Jumpman branding hits at the tongue and heel. Lightweight cushioning is provided an off-white polyurethane midsole, featuring a visible Air-sole unit nestled in the heel.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Premium 'Valentine's Day'
products.body_html: Matching the red, pink, and creamy tones of the rest of the pack, the Dunk Low "Valentine's Day 2023" arrives with a rich red velvet-coloured suede base, which comes contrasted with creamy, white-chocolate coloured leather overlays. From here, pastel pink accents add a cute touch, highlighting the laces, heel tab, tongue tab and Nike Swoosh. Finally, a "Sail"-toned midsole is dipped into a pink rubber outsole to finish the 2023 Valentine's Day colour theme.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE PS 'Space Jam'
products.body_html: With its next offering, the Air Jordan 1 Mid is taking us all the way back to the mid-90s, celebrating one of the most famous colorways of the Tinker Hatfield-designed icon: the “Space Jam” 11. In the way of color blocking, this pair is near exact in its impression. Black patent meets smooth leather throughout the upper — both clad in a deep black much like its inspiration — while white midsoles and icy bottoms sit just underfoot. Branding, too, is reminiscent of the original, with a dark blue Jumpman applied to the mid-top’s tongue.

products.title: Salomon XT-6 Recut 'Monument Phantom'
products.body_html: The “Phantom” is dressed in a subtle grey that compliments the techy nature of the silhouette. All the functionality is still present, including the Quicklace, Ortholite Sole and Agile Chassis System which made these so popular amongst overly weather-proof fans of the GORP scene. With Salomon branding on the heel and LAB written on the toe, these still obtain that high-performance feel that has you believing you can traverse down a mountain at speed if need be, forgetting the years of inactivity that will most likely throw your hip out. For now, unleashing them onto the city streets is more than enough, not only saving yourself from any embarrassing falls but also those potentially-high medical bills.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low 'Midnight Navy Smoke Grey'
products.body_html: Created for the hardwood but taken to the streets, the Dunk returns with classic details and throwback hoops style. Channelling a vintage design back onto the streets, its padded, low-cut collar lets you comfortably take your game anywhere.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Valentine's Day - Yellow Heart'
products.body_html: The “Yellow Heart” is largely devoid of any embellishment, save for (you guessed it) a yellow heart on its lateral heel, raised above the rest of the shoe, trimmed in white and stamped with a small Swoosh. From a construction standpoint, this low-cut Dunk uses white leathers both smooth and tumbled, while finishing details are served by an ever-so-faint yellow Swoosh plus yellow Nike Sportswear graphics on the tongue, heel and insole.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns LX 'Black Team Gold'
products.body_html: This low-top Dunk is covered in furry, comfy suede from heel to toe. The base is a warm-toned Bone colour while the overlays are dark Navy. Cream-coloured profile Swooshes outlined in grey suede complement the Bone base on both the medial and lateral mid-panels of the shoe. The tartan-patterned Navy and burgundy laces add a festive touch to the vamp. A vintage-looking Sail-coloured midsole and a Navy rubber outsole cap off the look of this shoe.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low 'Pure Platinum'
products.body_html: Nike's Dunk model first emerged on the courts in 1985, styled in collegiate colourways in high and low-top renditions. After being absent from the scene for a number of years, the Beaverton sportswear brand re-introduced the model through high-profile collaborations and classic two-toned outfits. Nike Dunk Low White Pure Platinum is arriving as a low-top counterpart to the Dunk High "White Pure Platinum".

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High '85 OG 'Black White'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High '85 OG 'Black White' also known as 'Panda,' sees an original colorway brought back by Jordan Brand trying to build it to the same specs as the 1985 OG. A simple two-tone leather upper mixes white and black across the shoe, with a black Swoosh complemented with a white Wings logo on the lateral profile. A Nike Air tongue tag arrives in black and white, matching the midsole and rubber outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS 'Twist 2.0'
products.body_html: Instead of opting for a clean black and white, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG “Twist” 2.0 comes in a shadow-like medium grey, black, and white colorway. OG-style colorblocking remains present, with a faux pony hair on the overlays and premium leather underlays.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low Wmns 'Barely Grape'
products.body_html: When Peter Moore introduced the Air Jordan 1 in 1985 as Michael Jordan's first signature basketball sneaker, it was an instant hit with the audience and sneaker enthusiasts. Today, the AJ1 is more than just a hoops classic; it's a lifestyle model loved by the masses. Now arriving in its classic low-top version, the Air Jordan 1 Low Barely Grape colourway is a must-have for fans of pastel colours.

products.title: adidas Samba OG 'Black Gum'
products.body_html: The adidas Samba OG originally came onto the scene in 1950 to protect soccer players’ feet from the icy ground during winter. Returning with classic distinction, this 'Black Gum' iteration's full-grain leather upper is upgraded with tonal suede around the toe and on the heel. Serrated Three-Stripes, a metallic foil logo and a Bluebird tongue label lend a vintage spirit. The rubber outsole rides underfoot, gripping with diverse tread.

products.title: adidas Samba Vegan 'White Gum'
products.body_html: The adidas Samba was first introduced as an indoor football shoe. They have gone on to cover expansive ground across the globe. Made with vegan alternatives to animal based materials. The look is exactly the same as the original, right down to the famous T-toe.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro 'UNC'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘UNC’ showcases a familiar pastel hue inspired by Michael Jordan’s alma mater. The upper is crafted from University Blue nubuck with tonal TPU eyelets, ventilated quarter-panel netting and a woven jock tag at the heel. An embroidered Jumpman decorates the tongue, rendered in a reflective silver finish for added visibility in low-light conditions. Lightweight cushioning comes courtesy of a black polyurethane midsole, accented with speckled shark-tooth detailing and fitted with a visible Air-sole unit in the heel. Underfoot, a translucent herringbone-traction outsole provides optimal grip.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low PS 'Active Fuchsia'
products.body_html:
First released in 1985, the Nike Dunk remains the classic poster child of Nike


This low-cut Dunk starts out with a classic “colourless” white smooth leather base. The titular Active Fuchsia comes in the form of the smooth leather overlays on the toe cap, the mudguard, the eye stay panel and the foxing. The laces, the mesh sock liner and the smooth leather profile Swooshes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels also follow the same shade of the overlays. A pure white midsole and an Active Fuchsia rubber outsole round out the design of this shoe.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro Wmns 'Seafoam'
products.body_html: The Women’s Air Jordan 4 Retro ’Seafoam’ combines OG-inspired color blocking, reminiscent of the original ‘Fire Red’ release from 1989, with classic materials and refreshed pastel accents. The upper is constructed from smooth white leather with contrasting pops of Oil Green on the eyelets, interior lining, and the Jumpman branding hits that adorn the Flight tongue tag and molded heel tab. Legacy details are left intact, including the quarter panel netting and support wings. The classic silhouette rides atop a polyurethane midsole, featuring a visible Air-sole unit in the heel and a final splash of green throughout the forefoot.

products.title: Puma Clyde Court 'City Pack - Los Angeles'
products.body_html: Puma gave the Clyde Court silhouette a makeover in five unique colorways that commemorate the NBA Draft. Launched in June 2019, the Puma Clyde Court 'City Pack - Los Angeles’ features a Prism Violet knitted upper with easy slip-on construction. Puma Formstrip branding appears on the lateral side. The external heel counter and lacing closure offer a snug fit while the midsole provides lightweight support to this Lakers-inspired sneaker.

products.title: Adidas Gazelle Bold Wmns 'Pulse Mint Screaming Pink'
products.body_html: The Gazelle Bold, featuring a stunning Pulse Mint suede base adorned with captivating leather Three Stripes and heel tabs in Screaming Pink. The lateral mid-panels boast opulent gold foil branding for an extra lux taste, complemented by textured tongues bearing additional Screaming Pink logos. To finish off, this stylish design is a triple-stacked Gum 2 rubber sole unit that adds height to your look!

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Pale Ivory Redwood'
products.body_html: Starting off with a smooth white leather base, this rendition is embellished with grey leather overlays and further spruced up by luxe-looking burgundy accents via the Swoosh, tongue tag and embroidered heel branding. This Nike Dunk is also complemented by matching flat laces and a breathable tongue. Underfoot, the lightweight sole unit provides full-length cushioning and a smooth ride. Perfect for elevating your casual 'fits!

products.title: Adidas Samba Vegan 'Black Gum'
products.body_html: The adidas Samba was first introduced as an indoor football shoe. They have gone on to cover expansive ground across the globe. Made with vegan alternatives to animal based materials. The look is exactly the same as the original, right down to the famous T-toe.

products.title: New Balance 90/60 x Bricks & Wood 'Nothing Changed but the Address'
products.body_html: Following suit with the current cream trend in sneakers, a hairy suede engulfs the upper and its varied panelling system. One of the most aggressive features is the jumbo mesh underlay, providing a technical edge to a shoe that looks to the future. The teeth-like midsole latches onto what appears like the more common 99X series midsole, an inventive update that separates the shoe from its inspirations. This is an impressive and important element of the shoe’s design. Green hits have also been added to the midsole, a colour that was so dominant on Bricks & Wood’s previous release. The hairy laces round off the tactile motif that the shoe explores, ensuring that these cannot be mistaken for a general-release pair.

products.title: Nike Air Max 97 Premium 'Light Bone'
products.body_html: Nike celebrated the 20th anniversary of the iconic Air Max 97 with a handful of premium editions including this ‘Light Bone’ iteration. The silhouette’s trademark wave is rendered in bright white mesh and Off-White leather. The light look continues underfoot with a white full-length Max Air unit and matching rubber outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'White Cement'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘White Cement’ showcases the signature design feature of the Air Jordan 3: namely, Tinker Hatfield’s unique elephant print, composed of irregular lines etched throughout the high-top’s grey leather overlays. They’re contrasted by a white leather base and black leather construction on the high-cut collar and Swoosh. Additional branding elements take the form of a woven Nike Air tongue tag and a Wings logo stamped on the lateral collar flap. Encapsulated Air-sole cushioning enhances the aged off-white midsole, supported underfoot by a grey rubber outsole.

products.title: Nike Dunk High SE 'All Star 2021'
products.body_html: Celebrating the NBA’s midseason break, the Nike Dunk High ‘All Star 2021’ delivers an eye-catching two-tone colorway of the retro hoops shoe. The upper combines a pistachio-hued leather base with contrasting patent leather overlays in a glossy black finish. A standard Nike woven tag decorates the tongue, while an NBA All-Star emblem is stitched onto the lateral heel. The high-top is mounted on a standard rubber cupsole, featuring a pivot-ready traction pattern originally designed for the hardwood.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid PS 'Cement True Blue'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Mid 'True Blue' features a white leather upper with perforations on the toe box for breathability, True Blue accents on the mudguard, eyestay, padded collar, and on the oversized Swoosh that spans around the heel.

products.title: New Balance 2002R 'Protection Pack - Navy'
products.body_html: A shoe made for fans of shoes with an edgy aesthetic, the New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Navy delights in a stylishly rugged design. The pair begins with a blue breathable mesh base that fills up the forefoot and ankle while the rest, including the toe and side panels, are enveloped in dark navy premium pig suede material with fashionable frayed edges. A black leather tongue devoid of branding, along with hits of white via the leather accents, adds a touch of sleekness. This 2002R rendition closes with a chunky midsole packed with shock-absorbing N-ergy cushioning and an ABZORB SBS heel cushioning for unmatched comfort.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'White Cement Reimagined'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'White Cement Reimagined' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro 'White Cement Reimagined'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'White Cement Reimagined' brings back one of the original colorways, celebrating the 35th anniversary of the AJ3. Designed by Tinker Hatfield, the Reimagined iteration is built to the original 1988 specs. Returning true to form, the white leather upper pairs with elephant print overlays on the heel and toe while hits of Varsity Red appear on the lace loops and the Jumpman logo on the tongue. Nike Air is emblazoned on the back heel tab, while a visible Air unit provides lightweight cushioning. A slight hint of yellowing appears on the back heel and midsole, giving the shoe a vintage look.

products.title: Adidas Gazelle Indoor Wmns 'Blue Fusion Gum'
products.body_html: The Adidas Gazelle Indoor Wmns 'Blue Fusion Gum' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Nike Dunk Low SE Wmns 'Sandrift'
products.body_html: Boasting “Hemp” tones on both the toe box and side panelling, a fine suede looks to be the outfit for the underlying fabric. Contrast stitching makes its way onto the Sandrift-coloured tip, Swoosh and heel, uniting the upper. The leather tongue patch provides a premium element which rounds off the shoe’s elegant aesthetic. You can expect all the standard comfort with Nike using the classic Dunk midsole and regular insole.

products.title: Nike Air Max Plus 'Baltic Blue'
products.body_html: The Nike Air Max Plus 'Baltic Blue' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Citron Pulse'
products.body_html: The standout Nike Dunk Low Citron Pulse boasts a striking design that will catch your eye even from afar. Featuring a well-balanced contrasting look, it comes with a smooth grey leather base, which is showcased at the perforated toe, quarters and rear, and hits of lemon yellow via the leather overlays, flat laces and tongue tag branding. The zesty vibes continue at the inner lining and the lightweight outsole. Other noteworthy details include the embroidered grey “NIKE” label at the heel tab and the classic Nike Dunk Low midsole with full-length cushioning.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro x Nike SB 'Pine Green'
products.body_html:
We’ve seen the two Nike divisions collaborate together in the past, most commonly on the Air Jordan 1, a silhouette that has deep ties within skateboarding culture. The last time we saw them team up was on the Nike SB x Air Jordan 1 High “LA to Chicago”, a shoe that slowly transitioned into the Chicago Bulls colourway the more you skated in them. We expect the same level of storytelling on this Air Jordan 4 release and we know sneakerheads have got high hopes too.


An off-white leather is used for the majority of the upper on this pair. Underfoot you’ve got a sneakerhead staple with the gum outsole, a feature you can spot on a number of different SB Dunks. On the heel, find a Nike SB logo instead of the usual Jumpman or Nike Air, which is a first for the AJ4. Another major change arrives in the form of the suede toe, a detail introduced thanks to its skate-friendly ability to withstand wear against scrapes and snags. Following the standard procedure are the other traditional AJ4 features, such as the netting and wings that keep the shoe rooted in its basketball DNA.

products.title: AMBUSH x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Black'
products.body_html: The Bruce Kilgore-designed Air Force 1 has always been the perfect canvas for collaborators, with a contemporary profile suitable for endless designs. This iteration with the Japan-based brand is borrowing the same theme as the AMBUSH x Nike Dunk High in 2020, with Swooshes extending past the heels. In terms of colour arrangement, this pair opts for a black leather base with contrasting white details via the tongue branding and the aforementioned Swoosh logo. Co-branded metallic lace dubraes and the AF1's chunky Air midsole beneath the feet complete this collaboration.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid Wmns 'Cement Grey'
products.body_html: At a closer look, you'll notice that this AJ1 Mid opts for tumbled leather panels in place of smooth leather, giving the pair a premium touch. Black takes over the toe boxes, quarters, and collars, leaving the overlaying panels to indulge in the titular "Cement Grey" hue. Nike and Jordan branding details in white balance out the contrast, like the Swoosh logos, Jumpman tag on the tongues, and the Wings insignia. A full-length Air midsole unit beneath the feet offers all day comfort and completes the 1985 Peter Moore-designed Jordan trainers.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Washed Black'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Washed Black’ gives the heritage silhouette a refreshed build in neutral tones. The high-top dons a white leather upper with grey suede overlays and a color-matched Swoosh. A lighter shade of grey suede is utilized on the high-cut collar, which is overlaid with an ankle flap marked with the iconic Wings logo. Atop the breathable nylon tongue, a woven Nike tag in black and red delivers a solitary pop of color. Underpinning the sneaker is a vintage off-white midsole, supported underfoot by a grippy black rubber outsole.

products.title: New Balance 990v1 Made in USA x Teddy Santis 'Tan Green'
products.body_html: The Teddy Santis x New Balance 990v1 Made in USA ‘Tan Green’ applies complementary earth tones to the legendary running shoe that kicked off the venerable 990 series. The upper combines sand-colored mesh with tonal pigskin suede overlays at the forefoot and saddle. Hairy suede paneling in a dark tan finish wraps around the heel, while green leather is utilized on the signature ‘N’ logo and heel tab. The retro silhouette rides on a lightweight ENCAP midsole, supported underfoot by a durable Vibram rubber outsole.

products.title: A Ma Maniére x Wmns Air Jordan 12 Retro SP 'White'
products.body_html: The A Ma Maniére x Wmns Air Jordan 12 Retro SP ‘White’ pairs high-caliber materials with traditional two-tone colour blocking. Stitched lines radiate outward on the white leather upper, fortified with midfoot overlays in a contrasting burgundy hue. Quilted textile lines the collar and insole, bringing back a design motif showcased on each of the Atlanta retailer’s previous Jordan collaborations. Mismatched Jordan and A Ma Maniére branding decorates each tongue and heel tab. The mid-top rides on a cushy Phylon midsole, enhanced with a full-length Zoom Air unit and a carbon fiber spring plate.

products.title: New Balance 2002R 'Protection Pack - Grey'
products.body_html: From afar, you wouldn’t be amiss to think these were a standard pair of New Balance 991 or 992. Doing a double take will reveal, however, that the extra details sprinkled on the upper are what makes this release so distinct. The grey, beige and white split on the midsole is what can initially throw you off, echoing a staple feature on the highly regarded NB 992 series. A tightly woven mesh provides a breathable edge to the shoe, partially swallowed up by the jagged cuts of the overlaying panels. The tongue has also received the deconstructed treatment with its uneven edges sticking out high above the laces. The branding on the midsole and collar region receives a dash of red, whereas the sidewall and bottom eyestay keep things minimal.

products.title: Bad Bunny x Adidas Forum Buckle Low GS 'Blue Tint'
products.body_html: The Bad Bunny x Adidas Forum Buckle Low GS 'Blue Tint' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Adidas Handball Spezial 'Navy Gum'
products.body_html: The adidas Handball Spezial Collegiate Navy is here to accompany you in your everyday adventures! Originally released in 1979 and made for handball players, the adidas Handball Spezial is now a sneakerhead-favourite lifestyle shoe that you can wear in multiple settings. This modern reincarnation is clad in soft navy blue nubuck upper and pastel blue leather overlays including the serrated Three Stripes branding. The lightweight tongue, snug lace closure, OrthoLite sockliner and a sturdy gum rubber outsole finish off this versatile pair.

products.title: Adidas Gazelle 'Collegiate Green Hazy Sky'
products.body_html: This Gazelle is clad in an all-suede upper in the titular Collegiate Green. Contrasting Hazy Sky accents come in the form of the jagged-edged leather Three Stripes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels and the heel tabs. The textured tongues feature royal blue labels with white adidas branding. Signature gold foil Gazelle branding on the lateral side of the shoe provides an elegant touch. A semi-translucent caramel-coloured gum outsole finishes off the style of this sneaker.

products.title: adidas Gazelle Bold Wmns 'Pink Glow Gum'
products.body_html: This Gazelle Bold has a Pink Glow suede upper from heel to toe. The sawtooth-edged leather Three Stripes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels are in contrasting Victory Blue. The tongue label branding, the insole branding and the unbranded heel tabs both follow suit. A lighter bubblegum pink graces the textured tongue, the sock liner, the laces and the insole. A triple-stacked caramel-coloured gum rubber outsole rounds out the look of this charming shoe.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG PS 'Starfish'
products.body_html: MJ's original Air Jordan 1 now comes dressed in a ”Starfish” colorway. Crafted with leather overlays and white leather underlays, the classic sneaker is finished off by OG branding

products.title: Nike Air Max 1 City Pack 'Amsterdam'
products.body_html: The Air Max 1 City Pack ‘Amsterdam’ uses premium materials on a colorway inspired by the Dutch capital. The retro runner carries a grey suede upper with a brown leather saddle and suede heel panel in Dusty Peach. The latter features an embroidered graphic depicting a map of Amsterdam’s canals, while three red crosses on the lateral forefoot are lifted from the city’s coat of arms. The kicks released alongside a London colorway to complete the two-piece City Pack.

products.title: Adidas Gazelle Wmns 'Bold Orange Gum'
products.body_html: This low-cut Gazelle has an all-suede upper in Bold Orange from heel to toe. The smooth leather serrated-edged Three Stripes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels, on the other hand, are in contrasting Cloud White. The unbranded heel tabs follow suit. Cloud White classic adidas Trefoil branding embellishes the textured tongues. Gold foil “Gazelle” text stands out on the lateral sides of the shoe. A caramel-coloured gum sole unit caps off the style of this shoe.

products.title: Nike Dunk High PS 'Football Grey Black'
products.body_html: Paying homage to its ‘80s basketball roots, the Nike Dunk High Aluminium PS will add a hit of vintage style to any of your little one’s looks. Its leather upper is accented with contrasting Swoosh detailing and Nike branding. The perforated toe box allows for ventilation, the cushioned midsole offers comfort and the rubber outsole provides grip. Fastened with a classic lace closure.

products.title: New Balance 9060 'Sea Salt'
products.body_html: This NB 9060’s upper has a breathable white mesh base. The suede and leather overlays that wrap around the shoe are in various shades of light grey. The suede tongues show off tongue label cutouts with grey jewel-like NB branding. Metallic silver “N” logos stand out on the lateral sides of the shoe while stylized embroidered “N” logos can be found on the medial side. A cream and off-white midsole that features ABZORB and SBS cushioning technology and grey rubber outsole cap off the design of this sneaker.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Wizards'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Washington Wizards’ showcases a familiar design based on a PE colorway that Michael Jordan wore during his time in D.C. Featuring color blocking reminiscent of the OG ‘True Blue’ edition from 1988, the classic silhouette makes use of a white tumbled leather upper with grey elephant-print overlays at the toe and heel. Contrasting blue accents appear on the interior lining, molded eyelets, and the raised Jumpman logo that decorates the heel tab. A second Jumpman graces the tongue in copper-colored embroidery, matching the circular eyelets that dot the forefoot. The mid-top is mounted on a two-tone polyurethane midsole, equipped with a visible Air-sole heel unit and supported by a durable grey rubber outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Wmns 'Washed Pink'
products.body_html: The Women’s Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Washed Pink’ delivers a pastel colorway of the foundational silhouette. The high-top dons a white leather upper with soft suede overlays in a muted pink hue. An aged pre-yellowed finish is applied to the midsole and breathable nylon tongue, the latter accented with a woven Nike tag. Additional branding elements include a pink suede Swoosh and an off-white Wings logo stamped on the lateral ankle. Underfoot, a pink rubber outsole features a traction pattern originally designed for pivoting on the hardwood.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low Wmns 'Panda'
products.body_html: The beloved binary colour scheme makes its way onto the upper, giving the necessary panels a hit of black and white. The Swoosh is drabbed in black leather along with the heel, collar, lace and toe guard. A white toe box and side wall give the shoe a balanced contrast, similar to the effect of the Nike “Panda” Dunk. The Wings insignia is embroidered on the heel in white while the Jumpman on the tongue leaps in black. The same white midsole and black tread combination is used to match the upper, adding to the shoe’s wearability. Expect a decent level of comfort when wearing this Air Jordan 1 Low, thanks to the mix of a rubber outsole and the leather quality above. While these might not be as comfy as one of your Air Max silhouettes, the stripped back cushioning is suitable for almost any task at hand.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Gorge Green'
products.body_html: This Dunk Low has a classic “colourless” smooth white leather base. The overlays on the toe cap, the mudguard, the eye stay panel, the foxing and the heel tab are in deep and sumptuous Gorge Green. Midnight Navy joins the colour scheme via the signature profile Swooshes on both the medial and the lateral mid-panels as well as the embroidered Nike text branding on the heel tabs. A white midsole and a Gorge Green rubber outsole round out the design of these kicks.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Plum Eclipse'
products.body_html: The Dunk Low sneakers have been through many reincarnations but Nike’s recent makeover feels so elegant and refined. Labelled as Plum Eclipse, the new colour way sees brown-purple leather panels contrasting with a beige suede base that’s dotted with airy ventilation ports on the toebox. The Swoosh appliqué coordinates with the overlays and comes in a tonal, less saturated hue. Earthy hits of near-translucent brown arrive via the gum outsoles, while the midsole keeps things balanced in clean white. The tongues and debossed heels add further branding cues.

products.title: UGG Classic Ultra Mini Driftwood (Kids)
products.body_html: The light brown suede upper sticks to the iconic UGG palette that makes the brand so recognisable. Updating the iconic silhouette with a lower shaft height, the new Classic Ultra Mini Boot is now that much easier to take on and off. These are pre-treated so that the Boot will look better for longer, giving you more of a chance to rock these with the endless amounts of outfits that these work with. The Treadlite outsole boasts extra comfort and is where you can find a unique tread pattern with a central UGG logo. The most obvious branding can be found on the leather heel label that details an embossed UGG spell-out logo.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Indigo Haze'
products.body_html: On the top portion, we are welcomed by a tasteful indigo which leans against the cream panelling for extra balance. These go hand-in-hand to give the Dunk a pastel vibe and a calm backdrop for the vibrant pink Swoosh to tell its own story. The embroidered “Nike” on the heel tab follows suit and is the only other feature on the shoe that adopts this bright pink. The standard rubber midsole also mimics the theme above, mixing the two colours elegantly.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid Wmns 'Strawberries and Cream'
products.body_html: This mid-cut AJ1 has an all-smooth-leather upper with pure white as the base and a candy pink colour on the toe cap, the mudguard, the eyestay panel, the collar flaps, the signature profile Swooshes on both sides of the shoe and the heel counter. The collar underlay, on the other hand, is a delicate light pink while the tongues are a creamy Sail colour. The pink tongue tab is adorned with a white Jumpman while the pink insole has a darker pink Jumpman. A light pink “Wings” logo is stamped onto the lateral collar flap. Down below a Sail-coloured midsole and a pink rubber outsole wrap up the look of these kicks.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low PS 'Black Midnight Navy'
products.body_html: Made for little kids, the Nike Dunk Low PS ‘Black Midnight Navy’ complements the shoe’s timeless lines with varying shades of blue. The leather upper combines a dark navy base with black overlays at the forefoot and heel. Game Royal accents make their way to the Swoosh and heel tab, accented with a Nike wordmark in embroidered black lettering. The low-profile silhouette rests on a rubber cupsole, featuring white sidewalls and a grippy black rubber outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Lucky Green'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Lucky Green’ dresses the iconic silhouette in familiar color blocking that mirrors one-half of the 2009 Air Jordan 1 ‘Defining Moments Pack,’ inspired by Michael Jordan’s 63-point playoff performance against the Boston Celtics in 1986. The high-top sports a smooth leather upper, featuring a white base with contrasting hits of black on the forefoot overlay, Swoosh, and padded collar. Lush green accents land on the heel overlay and ankle flap, marked with a retro Wings logo on the lateral side. The shoe earns its OG designation with a woven Nike tag atop the breathable nylon tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low GS 'Desert Berry'
products.body_html: This low-top smaller-sized AJ1 has a white leather base showing on the toe box and the mid-panel. The smooth leather overlays on the toe cap, the mudguard, the eye stay panel, the collar and the heel counter are in the titular Desert Berry shade. The mesh tongues follow suit. The signature profile Swooshes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels are in a light Coral hue, matching the embroidered Jumpman logos on the tongues, the tongue lining and the sock liners. A pristine white midsole and a Coral-coloured rubber outsole cap off the style of this shoe.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low 'Racer Blue Photon Dust'
products.body_html: This version of the Nike Dunk Low turns the familiar "Kentucky" colourway upside down and gives it an alternative look. The base, the Swooshes, the midsoles, the inner lining, the rear branding, and the tongues are all wrapped in a clean white. The outsoles, overlays, and laces feature the bright blue.

products.title: Converse Chuck 70 High x Stüssy 'Fossil'
products.body_html: For their third collaboration with Converse, Stüssy presents a limited edition flip of the Chuck 70 that’s inspired by surf culture. The Converse x Stüssy Chuck 70 is fashioned with a premium all hemp upper and pearlized studs that references vintage Chucks from the '90s and Stüssy’s subversive double S logo. Archival textures. Iconic logos.

products.title: New Balance 2002R 'Protection Pack - Driftwood'
products.body_html: An upper constructed of different suedes and mesh sets the stage for the return of the jagged panelling, a heavily desired feature. The shoe is predominantly covered in the titled “Khaki” colour, with beige hits sparingly used on the side and heel portion. New Balance’s traditional grey can be located throughout the branding by the laces and even on the collar where the model’s “2002R” sits. The inside is built up of a soft white felt that hugs your foot upon each wear. The midsole, as is often the case, is split into two different tones. A darker khaki wraps its way around the ABZORB cushioning unit, whereas the ENCAP technology is draped in an off-white.

products.title: Nike Lahar Low Wmns 'Triple Black'
products.body_html: The Nike women’s Lahar Low ‘Triple Black’ presents a stealthy colorway of a rugged silhouette based on the Lahar Escape Boot from 1989. The low-top makes use of a black suede upper, secured with rope laces fed through polished metal eyelets. Exterior branding is limited to a Nike wordmark on the webbing pull tab and a tonal mini-Swoosh on the tongue and lateral side panel. The lightly speckled sole unit, enhanced with Nike Air cushioning in the heel, features a trail-ready traction pattern.

products.title: Nike Air Max 97 'Muslin Pink Foam'
products.body_html: The Nike Air Max 97 ‘Muslin Pink Foam’ dresses the retro runner in complementary earth tones. The upper combines off-white hemp canvas with wavy tonal leather overlays and a brown suede mudguard. Embroidered mini-Swooshes adorn the tongue and quarter panel, while a webbing pull tab at the heel features Air Max branding. A full-length Air-sole unit provides soft landings and a smooth ride. Nike’s waffle traction pattern is utilized on the gum rubber outsole, infused with 10% cork and accented with contrasting hits of Pink Foam.

products.title: Nike Dunk High 'USA'
products.body_html: The base of this Dunk High is smooth and perforated leather in pure “colourless” white. The tumbled leather overlays on the toe cap, eye stay panel and foxing are in vibrant, eye-catching red. Tumbled leather profile Swooshes in blue on both sides of the shoe complete all three patriotic colours of the USA flag. A red basketball with a Swoosh adorns the white tongue tab while classic Nike branding in blue can be found on the red insole. A simple all-white sole unit rounds out the look of these kicks.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Lucky Green' PS
products.body_html: Offered in little kid sizing, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS ‘Lucky Green’ merges a vivid palette with familiar color blocking in the style of the original ‘Black Toe’ release from 1985. The timeless silhouette carries a smooth leather upper, highlighted by a white base with contrasting hits of black on the Swoosh and forefoot overlay. Lush green accents make their way to the heel and collar flap, branded with a retro Wings logo on the lateral side. The verdant hue makes a final appearance on the rubber outsole, featuring a traction pattern designed to grip the hardwood.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid PS 'Valentine's Day 2023'
products.body_html: This smaller-sized mid-top AJ1 boasts a white foundation and pink accents. Crafted with a smooth leather base and mesh tongues, Desert Berry adorns the signature profile Swoosh logos on both the medial and lateral mid-panels and the internal linings. A lighter Coral Chalk can be found on the toe cap, the mudguard, the eye stay panels, the collar flaps and the hee counter. A pure white midsole and a Desert Berry rubber outsole complete the look of this shoe.

products.title: Adidas Yeezy Boost 350 'Pirate Black' 2022
products.body_html: The Adidas Yeezy Boost 350 'Pirate Black' 2022 is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Adidas Campus 00s 'Silver Pebble Black'
products.body_html: This low-cut Campus 00s has a Silver Pebble premium suede upper from heel to toe. Contrasting Core Black sawtooth-edged Three Stripes grace both the medial and lateral mid-panels and match the laces and heel tabs. Black branding can be found on the tongues while simple Silver Pebble Trefoil logos adorn the heel tabs. “Campus” branding is embossed on the lateral side, right above the Three Stripes. A Core Black EVA midsole and rubber outsole wrap up the style of this shoe.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS 'Washed Pink'
products.body_html: Offered in little kid sizing, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS ‘Washed Pink’ brings together pastel accents and a worn aesthetic. The high-top sports a white leather upper with suede overlays in a faded pink finish. A woven Nike tag embellishes the breathable nylon tongue, while the lateral ankle is marked with the iconic Wings logo. The sneaker is mounted on traditional cupsole tooling, highlighted by pre-yellowed sidewalls and a durable pink rubber outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Thunder' 2023
products.body_html: The 2023 edition of the Air Jordan 4 Retro ‘Thunder’ brings back the coveted colorway originally released in 2006 (and previously reissued in 2012). The upper is draped in smooth black nubuck, contrasted by hits of yellow on the molded eyelets, quarter panel, and lower tongue, with the latter two components covered in black netting. Jumpman branding appears on the Flight tongue tag and molded heel tab. Lightweight cushioning comes courtesy of a yellow polyurethane midsole, enhanced with an exposed Air-sole unit in the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro PS 'Thunder' 2023
products.body_html: Crafted for little kids, the 2023 reissue of the Air Jordan 4 Retro GS ‘Thunder’ brings back a two-tone colorway that originally launched in 2006 and was previously released in 2012. Smooth black nubuck is utilized on the upper, accented with contrasting hits of Tour Yellow on the shoe’s molded eyelets, quarter panel and lower tongue. A raised Jumpman logo adorns the heel tab in white, matching a second Jumpman on the woven tongue tag. The mid-top is mounted on a yellow foam midsole, reinforced underfoot by a black herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Washington Wizards'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PS 'Washington Wizards' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro TD 'Washington Wizards'
products.body_html: Scaled down for tiny feet, the Air Jordan 3 Retro TD ‘Washington Wizards’ takes inspiration from a PE colorway that Michael Jordan wore during the 2001 – 2002 NBA season. The mid-top sports a white tumbled leather upper with grey elephant overlays at the forefoot and heel. Contrasting pops of color arrive via a copper Jumpman atop the tongue, along with molded eyelets and a textile collar lining in True Blue. The latter hue is repeated on a second Jumpman logo on the molded heel tab. A two-tone foam midsole delivers lightweight cushioning with every step.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Wmns 'Light Steel Grey Canvas'
products.body_html: This mid-top AJ1 SE Canvas swaps out its leather construction with canvas. The base of the shoe is pure white, showing on the toe box and the mid-panels. The toe cap, mudguard, eye stay panels and collar underlay are all in pitch black. The laces and the embroidered signature profile Swooshes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels follow suit. The collar flaps and the heel counters, on the other hand, are in the titular Steel Grey. The Jumpman logos on the white tongue tabs are Steel Grey whilst the stylised Wings logos on the collar flaps are black. A speckled Steel Grey sole unit wraps up the style of these kicks.

products.title: Sporty & Rich x Adidas Samba OG 'Cream Blue'
products.body_html: Sporty & Rich hits up its doubles partner adidas for another tasteful footwear capsule. Staying true to the success of its first collaborative collection which dropped towards the end of 2022, the LA-based lifestyle brand serves up the Samba in a classy “Beige Blue” make-up.

products.title: Sporty & Rich x Adidas Samba OG 'White Black'
products.body_html: The Sporty & Rich x Adidas Samba OG 'White Black' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Sporty & Rich x Adidas Samba OG 'Blue Rush'
products.body_html: The Sporty & Rich x adidas Samba Blue blends the activewear brand’s ease with the sneaker authority’s footwear kudos. This rendition has a tumbled leather base in bright turquoise and comes overlaid with tonal suede on the mudguard and along the eye stays. The heel inlay, also in suede, introduces an off-white shade also used for the laces and signature Three Stripes. It’s also detailed with cobranding. Continuing the logo element is the SPORTY & RICH lettering above the top stripe as well as the branded tongue. Finally, the rubber midsole comes textured for reduced wear and tear and is patterned underfoot to provide traction.

products.title: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LX 'Mica Green'
products.body_html: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LX 'Mica Green' features a premium smooth all-leather upper with a pale green base and sage green overlays. The padded tongue and flat laces are also in the same shade for visual unity. Meanwhile, hits of cream via the Nike Swoosh, heel overlay and chunky sole unit further the shoe’s understated luxurious look.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low 'Mica Green'
products.body_html: This low-cut Dunk is constructed from premium tumbled leather and canvas. The base is light grey Photon dust while the tumbled leather overlays on the toe cap, the mudguard, the eye stay panel and the foxing are all in the titular Mica Green. White signature profile Swooshes glide across both the medial and lateral mid-panels. Mica Green Nike branding stands out on the white tongue tabs and the white heel tabs. A vintage-looking Sail-coloured sole unit finishes off the style of these kicks.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse'
products.body_html: The Marvel x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse’ delivers a collaborative colorway tied to the animated film of the same name. A play on the original ‘Chicago’ colorway, this reimagined take on the sneaker icon features a white leather upper with black patent leather on the collar and Swoosh. Scarlet overlays are composed of a patchwork mix of different textures and prints — a pieced-together design that nods to the multidimensional Spider-Verse. A retro Wings logo is stamped on the lateral collar flap, while a woven Nike tag decorates the nylon tongue. The high-top rides on a rubber cupsole that pairs aged sidewalls with a crimson semi-translucent rubber outsole.

products.title: Adidas Campus 00s 'Black White Gum'
products.body_html: This Campus 00s has an all-suede upper in Core Black. Contrasting Cloud White sawtooth-edged smooth leather Three Stripes sweep across both the medial and lateral mid-panels. The Core Black suede heel tabs and tongues show off Cloud White Trefoil logos devoid of any text branding. adidas text branding, on the other hand, can be found on the Core Black insoles. An Off White midsole, a legacy of the OG Campus, and a caramel-coloured gum outsole complete the design of this shoe.

products.title: Nike Air Max 1 Premium 'Shima Shima' 2023
products.body_html: The 2023 edition of the Nike Air Max 1 Premium ‘Shima Shima’ brings back a design motif originally showcased in the ‘Shima Shima’ pack from 2003. Varying shades of grey are applied to the leather upper, accented with contrasting hits of brown on the signature Swoosh and nubuck mudguard. Vertical stripes decorate the interior textile lining, while Japanese Hiragana characters spell out ‘Shima Shima’ on the woven tongue tag and sockliner. Lightweight cushioning arrives via a wedge-shaped foam midsole with a visible Air-sole unit in the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE Wmns 'Light Steel Grey'
products.body_html: Arriving in a canvas construction, this Special Edition of the Air Jordan 1 Low taps into the lifestyle element that the shoe currently represents. Soft tones and matching stitching complement the simplicity of the low-cut silhouette, a shoe once heavily associated with its basket balling roots. An embroidered Swoosh is a playful addition that separates this pair from the rest of the AJ1 Low releases. The Wings insignia is here in its traditional form, a white thread detailing its feathered outlines that was designed by the legendary Peter Moore. Keeping it classic is the ’85 sole that ensures you remain steady and, in this case, lets the upper receive all the attention.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Wmns 'Canyon Rust Blue'
products.body_html: The Dunk's timeless style allow it to opt for in-line variants like this "Rust Blue" rendition, which sees a leather setup in navy and burgundy. Giving it a contrasting touch are Nike branding details like the Swooshes, "Nike Air" tongue label, and "NIKE" embroidered text on the heel tabs. A cushioned midsole unit beneath the feet in white and the titular hue complete this covetable Nike Dunk trainers.

products.title: Adidas Campus 00s 'St Forest Glade'
products.body_html: This Campus’ upper, made from partly recycled content, is premium suede with a deep Forest Glade hue. Contrasting Cloud White jagged-edged Three Stripes stand out on both the medial and lateral mid-panels. The adidas branding on the padded suede tongue and the white heel tab are a slightly darker version of Forest Glade. “Campus” text branding is stamped onto the lateral side of the shoe, right above the Three Stripes. An Off White midsole and a caramel-coloured gum rubber outsole cap off the design of these kicks.

products.title: Adidas Campus 00s 'Grey Gum'
products.body_html: The adidas Campus 00s is a sneaker legend with illusively simple looks, but this Grey Off White iteration is as timeless as ever. It has a smooth suede upper set in a panelled construction with overlaid eye stays and heels. Signature serrated Three Stripes land on the medial side in a white shade and come separated by perforated rows. The top stripe is framed with CAMPUS lettering. Further branding elements include the Trefoil motif on the tongue and raw heel. The laces are flat yet thick and offset the overall minimalist silhouette slightly. Finally, the cream midsole is edged with brown gumming underfoot.

products.title: Nike Dunk High PS 'Championship Red'
products.body_html: The Nike Dunk High PS 'Championship Red' is a classic sneaker that combines style and comfort. The shoe features a red and white colorway, with a leather upper and a rubber sole.

products.title: adidas Campus 00s 'Dark Green Gum'
products.body_html: adidas lends its Campus 00s sneakers a colourful makeover with this Dark Green iteration. The pair is closely modelled on classic styles and comes with signature Three Stripes and Trefoil branding on the tongue and heel. The upper arrives in smooth dark-green suede that’s contrasted with fresh-white accents via the laces, logo accents as well as the midsole, here rendered in a slight off-white hue. Further typical cues include the shiny foil CAMPUS lettering above the top stripe and the perforation rows separating the stripes. Underfoot, chevron-shaped ridges provide the traction you need.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low 'Celtics'
products.body_html: This low-cut Dunk comes in a striking combination of white, Lucky Green and black, perfectly matching the colours of the Boston Celtics. Lucky Green can be found on the mudguard, eye stay panels and heel, while the toe box, mid-panels and collar are all rendered in white. Tonal green laces lead up to a tongue tag with retro Nike branding and a mini Swoosh. The signature profile Swooshes on both the medial and lateral mid-panels are crafted from black suede. A white midsole and black rubber outsole wrap up the design of these kicks.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid Wmns 'White Snakeskin'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Wmns 'White Snakeskin' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: New Balance 9060 'Moon Daze'
products.body_html: This NB 9060 features a medley of mesh and brushed suede on the upper in the titular arctic grey. A navy padded tongue complements the rest of the upper. A silver "N" logo with an arctic grey suede outline embellishes the lateral side wall while a stylised stitched and dashed “N” logo can be found on the medial side. An icy semi-translucent heel clip provides stability at the rear. Capping off the look of these kicks are N-ERGY-enhanced midsoles equipped with ABZORB SBS heel cushioning and a diamond-patterned tread in two shades of blue.

products.title: adidas Yeezy Slides 'Azure'
products.body_html: The adidas Yeezy Slide ‘Azure’ showcases a vibrant blue finish on the futuristic comfort sandal, featuring a minimalist one-piece build made with injected EVA foam. Exterior branding is limited to the soft top layer of the footbed, highlighted by a discreet adidas logo debossed at the heel. The slip-on is underpinned by a serrated outsole with strategic ridge placement, offering a combination of impact protection and grip.

products.title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Carbon Beluga'
products.body_html: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Carbon Beluga’ brings together vivid pops of color with a patterned design. Rope laces secure the breathable Primeknit upper, rendered in a dark grey finish with wavy black lines and contrasting orange speckles. On the lateral side, a matching orange stripe displays ‘SPLY-350’ branding. Responsive cushioning is provided by a full-length Boost midsole, housed within a ribbed TPU cage and supported underfoot by a durable rubber outsole.

products.title: Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 Wmns 'Photon Dust Metallic Silver'
products.body_html: The Nike Women’s Air Zoom Vomero 5 ‘Photon Dust Metallic Silver’ brings gleaming accents to a retro running shoe built for all-day comfort. A refined light grey finish permeates the upper, built with a traditional blend of airy mesh and synthetic leather. Chrome detailing shines on the toe box and signature Swoosh, while a molded heel cage provides lightweight stability and support. The sneaker rides on a foam midsole with snappy Zoom Air cushioning nestled in the forefoot and heel.

products.title: adidas Gazelle Wmns 'Bliss Pink Purple'
products.body_html: Arriving in what adidas is calling the “Bliss Pink Purple” colourway, is an affordable alternative to the eye-watering prices of the Gucci x adidas Gazelle “Pink” collaboration. The upper is formed from a hairy suede from heel to toe, with a classic set of black leather 3-Stripes climbing onto the quarter. The heel tab introduces a regal shade of purple, complementing the iconic gold foil Gazelle lettering debossed above the stripes and tongue. Below, a semi-translucent gum sole keeps things traditional, while the pink laces head in a more contemporary direction.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Comfort 2 x Teyana Taylor Wmns 'A Rose From Harlem'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 High Zoom Comfort 2 x Teyana Taylor Wmns 'A Rose From Harlem' delivers the multi-talented artist’s take on the sneaker icon. The updated design is highlighted by an all-leather upper, featuring a crisp white base with forefoot and heel overlays in Gym Red and chocolate brown. An embroidered red Swoosh spiked with green thorns adorns the right shoe, while the opposite shoe is accented with an oversized black leather Swoosh outlined in zigzag stitching. The mismatched theme continues on each shoe’s woven tongue tag, with the right displaying a thorny Swoosh graphic, the left featuring ‘TEY’ in metallic gold lettering. Additional flourishes include etched Xes on the toe box, a rose-shaped lace jewel, and ‘A Rose From Harlem’ inscribed across the interior of each collar flap.

products.title: New Balance 990v4 Made in USA 'Grey Day 2023'
products.body_html: The Teddy Santis x New Balance 990v4 Made in USA is taken from the ‘Grey Day 2023’ collection, featuring classic silhouettes in the Boston brand’s signature color. This special-edition colorway of the 990v4 makes use of a light grey mesh upper, bolstered with hairy suede overlays in a darker shade of grey. The latter is outlined in navy suede trim, matching the signature ‘N’ logo that decorates the quarter panel. Lightweight cushioning comes courtesy of a two-tone ENCAP midsole, composed of a cushy foam core with a durable polyurethane rim.

products.title: New Balance 990v6 Made in USA 'Grey Day 2023'
products.body_html: Launching as part of the ‘Grey Day 2023’ collection, the New Balance 990v6 Made in USA dresses the lifestyle runner in the Boston brand’s signature color palette. Breathable light grey mesh is deployed on the upper, fortified with navy leather detailing and grey pigskin suede overlays. Reflective detailing on the tongue and heel tab offers enhanced visibility in low-light conditions. Undergirding the sneaker is New Balance’s ENCAP midsole, featuring FuelCell foam cushioning with a tough polyurethane rim.

products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Low GS 'Light Arctic Pink' is now available at Kick Game!

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Black Cement'
products.body_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG ‘Black Cement’ borrows an instantly recognizable design motif from the iconic Air Jordan 3. Grey elephant print appears on the shoe’s forefoot and heel overlays, while the rest of the upper is constructed from smooth black nubuck. Branding elements include a white leather Swoosh, woven Nike Air tongue tags, and a retro Wings logo embroidered on the heel tab. The low-top is mounted on a vintage off-white midsole, supported underfoot by a durable grey rubber outsole.

products.title: adidas Gazelle Indoor Wmns 'Collegiate Green Pink'
products.body_html: This Gazelle Indoor’s upper is constructed from suede in a lush “Collegiate Green”. The serrated-edged leather Three Stripes that glide across both the medial and lateral quarter panels are in contrasting white. The unbranded heel tabs and the insoles are in a pretty “Lucid Pink” colour. adidas branding on the tongue tabs and Gazelle text branding on the lateral side walls are in luxe metallic gold. A semi-translucent gum rubber sole unit finishes off the design of this sneaker.

products.title: Wales Bonner x adidas Samba 'Ecru Tint Yellow'
products.body_html: The Wales Bonner x adidas Samba ‘Ecru Tint Yellow’ is taken from a capsule collection centered around Jamaican sport style. Grace Wales Bonner’s take on the iconic silhouette features a tan nubuck upper with pale yellow three-stripes and deco stitching at the heel tab. Dual branding appears on the fold-over tongue, while ‘Wales Bonner’ is inscribed on the lateral heel. The sneaker rests on a low-profile rubber cupsole in a dark brown finish.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'UNC Toe'
products.body_html: Inspired by Michael Jordan’s alma mater, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘UNC Toe’ brings back the distinctive color blocking originally featured on the ‘Bred Toe’ AJ1 from 2018. The high-top utilizes an all-leather upper with white quarter panels and contrasting hits of black on the signature Swoosh and forefoot overlay. University Blue accents make their way to the toe box, heel and collar flap, marked with a retro Wings logo on the lateral side. A woven Nike tag atop the breathable nylon tongue delivers an OG-inspired touch. Lightweight cushioning arrives via a white rubber midsole with an Air-sole heel unit encapsulated in a polyurethane wedge. Underfoot, a blue rubber outsole provides durable traction with every step.

products.title: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Wmns 'Hemp'
products.body_html: The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Wmns 'Hemp' is a perfect, everyday casual shoe that’s worthy of a spot in your collection. This more eco-friendly reincarnation of Peter Moore’s 1985 design has a cocoa-coloured base with airy toe perforations. Meanwhile, “Sail” (an off-white hue) overlays complement the brown background. The lightweight tongue and flat laces finish the upper. Like its predecessors, this Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Wmns 'Hemp' also utilises synthetic leather crafted from recycled polyester.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS 'UNC Toe'
products.body_html: Inspired by Michael Jordan’s alma mater, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG PS ‘UNC Toe’ delivers a scaled-down model built for little kids. The high-top makes use of an all-leather upper, featuring a white quarter panel with contrasting black hits on the forefoot overlay, high-cut collar and signature Swoosh. University Blue accents make their way to the toe box, ankle and heel. The sneaker is mounted on a sturdy rubber cupsole that pairs white sidewalls with a Tar Heel blue rubber outsole.
